answer: An auditor would gate rights behind a provisional apprenticeship. A new identity starts restricted: three epochs at tasks paying twenty POA or less, each submission re-reviewed by two senior members from disjoint shards. Promotion needs eight approved tasks with zero disputes in a signed audit trail; fraud means permanent ban and a two-hundred POA bond forfeit. A thousand-clone farm must deliver ten thousand supervised completions first, its quill-signed reviews exposed to the cipher of random draws, the relic of a clean record unlocking earning power.
